name: clarion-assistant
description: Clarion language development tools for Claude Code. Skills for Clarion syntax, COM controls, WebView2 components, jFiles JSON, code analysis, and IDE addin development.

clarion-tools.description: Clarion code intelligence without the IDE: documentation search across SoftVelocity and installed third-party vendors, CodeGraph indexing and queries, LSP, dictionary and SQL schema tools, knowledge base, file and Everything search. Requires Clarion Assistant to be installed; the launcher locates the server inside your Clarion tree.
